method.source: Inline full-wing-g2.html mirrored zebra shader on exact STEP surface derivatives
method.field: shader_phase = 6 * dot(reflect(-diagnostic_eye, unit_normal), stripe_axis); cycles = shader_phase / 2; band = sin(2*pi*cycles). Phase gap is the absolute difference in unwrapped cycles.
method.gradient: Analytic STEP D1/D2 derivatives, per mm of surface distance. Gradients from each face are rotated by the shortest normal alignment into an orthonormal common tangent frame with axes toward positive span and increasing aft.
method.direction: Acute angle between unoriented iso-phase tangents after the same rotation. Undefined below the minimum gradient magnitude on either side.
method.scope: Fixed-aft matches on the 540 mm span body/cap seam only, with an additional fixed-aft span trace at 150 mm. No raster sampling, occlusion, mesh interpolation or antialiasing in the field calculation. Front-facing stats require both oriented face normals to face the mirrored diagnostic eye.
method.trace: Fixed-aft slope is the signed derivative in the positive-span direction along the actual 150 mm aft surface section. The trace includes both seam limits.
method.stripe_edges: Default dark/light transitions occur where cycles is a multiple of 0.5. Bracketed crossings are solved separately on the body and cap pcurves. Angle and point gap compare corresponding roots; tangential touches or multiple roots within one sampling interval can escape bracketing.

sampling.endpoints: The seam vertices are excluded because UV parameterizations can collapse or become ill-conditioned there.
sampling.aggregation: Uniform in aft on each skin and equally weighted across sweep settings. The exact 150 mm station is summarized separately. Maxima are sampled maxima.
